test_title: RRB NTPC UG 2025: शताब्दी शनिवार - Mega Live Test
subject: general
question:
**Direction:** Study the following information carefully and answer the questions.

Z 2 @ P N S 7 8 A B & 5 K R 6 # L F 3 + D * 3 $ V E M 9 H 4 * O Q

According to the above arrangement what should come in place of question mark in the following series 2@N, S7A, ?, R6L, F3D
solution:
**Given :**

**Main Series: **

**Left Side:** Z 2 @ P N S 7 8 A B & 5 K R 6 # L F 3 + D * 3 $ V E M 9 H 4 * O Q** :Right Side**

**Series in Question: **

2@N, S7A, ?, R6L, F3D

In each term of the series "2@N, S7A, ?, R6L, F3D" following pattern is being followed:

I: Second element is to the immediate right of the first element in the main series 

II. Third element is second to the right of second element.

III. The next element to the third element of a term is the first element of the next term. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ec81f60cb9ed22de158b7e610bbb13b064ee8c2df21e269d692ef5c3a8b0b4a.png] 

Hence, **B&K** **should come in place of question mark**
